_comment: Synthetic, fictional memories for the Answer Check demo. No real people, projects or data.
memories: Project Kestrel is the internal codename for the new field-service scheduling app.
Priya Raman leads design for Project Kestrel.
Project Kestrel's backend runs on PostgreSQL 17 with a Rust API layer.
We decided to ship Project Kestrel on iOS first and Android one quarter later.
Project Kestrel's beta has 40 pilot technicians in Pune.
The Kestrel team meets every Tuesday at 10:00 for a design review.
Kestrel's offline mode syncs job notes when a technician reconnects.
The Kestrel pilot found that route suggestions saved about 25 minutes per technician per day.
Project Kestrel uses feature flags so pilots can try new screens early.
Kestrel support tickets go to the field-tools queue.
Project Kestrel's app icon is a small falcon on a teal background.

abstained.q: What is Project Kestrel's marketing budget?
